decisions.reason: Glass-silicon wafers with vertical through contacts are a differentiated, R&D-intensive extension of the core packaging-wafer offer, aligned with the firm's strategy toward multifunctional packaging wafers, so withdrawing them shortly after launch is unlikely.

Carrier wafers for handling smaller-diameter wafers use existing polishing and drilling capabilities at low incremental cost and fit the stated direction toward reusable carriers and thin-wafer handling.
